;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**The [[Afghan National Army]] abandons the western [[Shib Koh District]] after the government failed to resupply troops stationed there. The district, which borders [[Iran]], is now effectively under [[Taliban]] control. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-security/afghan-forces-abandon-district-after-taliban-pressure-idUSKBN1OB1SH (Reuters)]
**The [[Taliban]] claims responsibility for a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] that killed 12 people, including 8 civilians in [[Kabul]]. [https://www.tolonews.com/afghanistan/blast-targets-security-forces-convoy-kabul (Tolo News)]
*Two police officers are injured after a man throws a [[grenade]] at them at a shopping centre in [[Nazran]], [[Ingushetia]], [[Russia]]. The attacker and his accomplice are later shot dead. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-12/13/c_137669668.htm (Xinhuanet)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] removes [[Australians|Australian]] [[prelate]] [[George Pell]] and [[Chileans|Chilean]] prelate [[Francisco Javier Errázuriz Ossa]] from the [[Council of Cardinal Advisers]]. Both are accused of covering up [[Catholic Church sexual abuse cases|child sexual abuse]] scandals. Former [[Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kinshasa|Archbishop of Kinshasa]] [[Laurent Monsengwo Pasinya]] also leaves the Council for unrelated reasons. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46539341 (BBC)]

;International relations 
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**Soldiers from [[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] peacefully cross the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone]] for the first time since it was created in [[1953]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/north-korea-south-korea-troops-cross-demilitarized-zone-in-peace-first-time/ (CBS News)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] accuses [[National Security Advisor (United States)|United States National Security Advisor]] [[John R. Bolton]] of personally leading a plot to assassinate him, declining to provide evidence. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-46546984 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Michael Cohen (lawyer)|Michael Cohen]], the former lawyer of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], is sentenced to three years in prison for making illegal hush money payments to two women with whom Trump allegedly had affairs, and a concurrent sentence of two months for making false statements to [[United States Congress|Congress]] about a possible Trump Tower deal in [[Russia]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/2177721/donald-trumps-former-lawyer-michael-cohen-sentenced (''South China Morning Post'')]
*Prosecutors in [[Goiás]], Brazil request the [[preventive detention]] of medium [[João de Deus (medium)|João de Deus]] over more than 200 allegations of sexual abuse. João de Deus became internationally famous in 2013, when his controversial psychic healing methods were broadcast on [[Oprah Winfrey]]'s show ''[[Oprah's Next Chapter]]''. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-healer-abuse/brazil-miracle-healer-who-appeared-on-oprah-faces-arrest-in-sex-probe-idUSKBN1OB2VS (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]], [[Next Conservative Party (UK) leadership election|Future Conservative Party leadership election]]
**By a vote of 200 to 117, [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] survives  a [[motion of no confidence]] within the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-46547246 (BBC)]
